versions.changelog:
Initial release—introducing memi-relationship-intelligence:

- Extracts and saves contacts from natural conversations, including all types of connections.
- Tracks commitments, relationship health (warming/cooling/cold), and interaction history.
- Delivers morning briefs, context before meetings, and reminders tailored to your style.
- Learns and adapts to your communication style, relationship priorities, and networking patterns.
- Uses an extensive SQLite database schema to store context, preferences, relationship events, archetypes, and more.
